title: yaks edge keyword vocabulary
description: The keyword @yaks/edge adds to a component vocabulary. A component declaring `relation` is a RELATION TAG: an edge entity wearing it states a link of that kind, so `cites` beside `edge{from,to}` is the sentence "this post cites that one". Which relations exist is the application's to declare — this keyword is how it says so.
$comment: A vocabulary declaration in the JSON Schema sense: a URI naming this keyword set, plus the schema of each keyword. A vocab file declares it under $vocabulary; a loader registers it with loadVocab(docs, [edgeKeywords]).

relation.description: This component tags an edge with the kind of link it states. `true` names the relation after the component itself (a `cites` component is the `cites` relation); a string names it something else, for a vocabulary whose tag and its reading differ (a `references` tag read as `referenced`).
